name: Dragon's Roar (SD1)
manual:
Dragon beatdown built around the Red-Eyes engine, with three Stamping Destruction to clear the way and a Dragon toolbox to grind.

## Boss line — Red-Eyes Darkness Dragon
Get **Red-Eyes Black Dragon** onto the field, then from your hand **Tribute it to Special Summon Red-Eyes Darkness Dragon**. Darkness Dragon is 2400 base and **gains +300 ATK for every Dragon in YOUR Graveyard**, so fill the yard first and it swings for 3000-4000+.
Three ways to land Red-Eyes Black Dragon:
- Normal Summon it (2400 vanilla body on its own).
- **Black Dragon's Chick**: send the Chick you control to the GY to Special Summon Red-Eyes Black Dragon *from your hand* — a Level 1 becomes your enabler for free.
- **Premature Burial / Call of the Haunted**: revive a Red-Eyes Black Dragon already in the GY, then tribute it up.
Stock the Graveyard before the summon (Masked Dragon deaths, the Armed Dragon send, Reload/Reckless Greed discards, the tributed Red-Eyes itself) so Darkness Dragon comes down big.

## Masked Dragon toolbox (x3)
Masked Dragon (1400) trades in combat, and **when destroyed by battle it Special Summons a Dragon with 1500 or less ATK straight from the Deck** — Twin-Headed Behemoth, Armed Dragon LV3, Element Dragon, Black Dragon's Chick, or another Masked Dragon. Every trade refuels the board AND loads a Dragon into the yard for Darkness Dragon.

## Armed Dragon climb
Normal Summon **Armed Dragon LV3**; on your next Standby Phase send it to the GY to Special Summon **Armed Dragon LV5** (2400). LV5 can **pitch a card from hand to destroy an opponent monster whose ATK ≤ the pitched monster's ATK** — spot removal attached to a real body. (No LV7 in this deck, so LV5 is the ceiling here.)

## Stamping Destruction (x3) — the deck's identity
With any face-up Dragon out (trivial in this deck), **destroy 1 Spell/Trap AND burn 500**. Three copies keep the opponent's backrow honest and open your attacks.

## Grind & disruption
- **Snatch Steal** — steal their best monster (also perfect tribute fodder for Darkness Dragon, or fodder to hand off with Creature Swap).
- **Creature Swap (x2)** — trade a spent/weak Dragon for their beater.
- **Curse of Anubis** — flip all Effect Monsters to Defense with DEF 0 and lock their positions; your Dragons then trample the board.
- **Dragon's Rage** — your Dragons deal piercing to Defense monsters; pairs with Curse of Anubis.
- **The Dragon's Bead** — discard 1 to negate and destroy a Trap that targets a face-up Dragon (protects your boss).
- **Twin-Headed Behemoth** — comes back once per Duel at 1000/1000 after it dies, a resilient wall.
- Draw/tempo: Pot of Greed, Reload, Reckless Greed (draw 2), Swords of Revealing Light to stall while you set up. Nobleman of Crossout (x2) answers face-downs; Heavy Storm / Mystical Space Typhoon clear backrow.

## Weaknesses
- ⚠ Slow and inconsistent: many one-ofs, no hand traps, and the boss line needs setup — a single Bottomless/removal on the freshly-summoned Darkness Dragon undoes a whole turn's investment.
- ⚠ Darkness Dragon is weak off an empty Graveyard, so a turn-1 Red-Eyes with nothing in the yard underwhelms.
- Power cards here (Snatch Steal, Premature Burial, Heavy Storm, Pot of Greed) are Forbidden in modern formats — this is a strong-for-2005 artifact that later decks outclass.
main: The Graveyard in the Fourth Dimension
